# Vendored dtach

Machinen vendors dtach 0.9 as a standalone helper executable.

- Upstream: https://dtach.sourceforge.net/
- Source archive: https://downloads.sourceforge.net/project/dtach/dtach/0.9/dtach-0.9.tar.gz
- SHA-256: `32e9fd6923c553c443fab4ec9c1f95d83fa47b771e6e1dafb018c567291492f3`
- License: GPL-2.0-or-later; see `COPYING`

`config.h` was generated by the upstream `configure` script on macOS and legacy
trailing whitespace was normalized. Local patches:

- make an attached viewer exit when its Machinen parent process disappears; the
  detached master and user command continue running;
- write a private `<socket>.status` sidecar containing process IDs, foreground
  process group, terminal mode, byte counters, and activity timestamps. Output
  content is never buffered in this file.

SwiftPM builds the source as the `machinen-dtach` helper. Machinen launches
viewers with `-E`, disabling dtach's detach character so terminal input remains
transparent.
